execution_invariant: No scaffold promotion. Each target must gain a dedicated mechanism, behavioral proof, adversarial proof, operable surface, truthful boundary, and source-bound completion evidence before terminal status.
donor_rule: Reuse verified mechanism patterns, not company branding. Donor references establish architectural leverage only; they do not imply company affiliation or production equivalence.
